svg.text: GeeNet - Guided Troubleshooting

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: What problem are you experiencing?

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [1] Internet connection problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Connected but no internet, or the internet stopped working.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [2] Wi-Fi problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Networks missing, cannot connect, keeps dropping, weak signal.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [3] Ethernet / wired problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Cable not detected, no link, wired connection problems.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [4] IP address / DHCP problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: No address, 169.254 address, gateway missing, conflicts.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [5] DNS / website name problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Names do not resolve, pages do not open, DNS is slow.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [6] Router / local network symptoms

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Router unreachable, ISP, other devices - find out whose fault it is.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [7] Slow internet

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Slow downloads, slow pages, high ping, busy connections.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [8] Connection stability / packet loss

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Random dropouts, freezing calls, lag in games.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [9] Website / application problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: One site or one app will not connect.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [10] VPN / proxy problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: VPN breaks the internet, proxy settings interfering.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [11] Windows network settings

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Stack, Winsock, services, resets, settings screens.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [12] Network adapter / driver problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Adapter disabled, missing, erroring, or failing later.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [13] Local network / LAN problems

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Other computers, shared folders, local servers, ARP, routes.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [14] Symptoms from a change you made

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: "It worked yesterday", "I installed a VPN", "I changed settings".

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [15] Something else / I am not sure

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Let GeeNet work out what is wrong for you.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: [0] Back to the main menu
